notes.title: 🛠️ Improving Everdark
notes.content:
🛠️ Improving Everdark – Visual & Audio Upgrades!
The launch of Everdark is getting closer, but we’re not slowing down—not even during the holidays! Our team is working hard to deliver the best possible visual and audio experience for you.

Here are some of the improvements we’re bringing to the game to make it shine:
[hr][/hr]
🎞️ Animation Improvements
We’ve added new animations and polished the existing ones to make every movement feel smoother and more immersive.

🧵 Texture Enhancements
Textures have been updated to be more detailed and visually consistent—say goodbye to low-quality or out-of-place visuals.

🎧 Sound & Music Overhaul
New sound effects and music tracks have been added to enhance the atmosphere and deepen the experience.

💡 Lighting Improvements
Everdark may be a dark game, but lighting matters more than ever. We’ve improved lighting quality to make shadows, contrasts, and ambiance more beautiful and dramatic.

🎨 Post-Processing Upgrades
We’ve added an extra layer of post-processing to elevate the game’s overall look—Everdark has never looked better.
[hr][/hr]
We hope you’ll enjoy all these updates and improvements as much as we’ve enjoyed working on them!

And this isn’t everything—we still have some surprises to reveal before launch. 👀

➡️ Add Everdark to your wishlist and follow us to stay updated and not miss anything!
